name: Nebraska

response.rule_text: Custodian must comply as soon as practicable, no more than four business days after receipt (§ 84-712(4)).

fees.labor_rule: Nonresidents may be charged proportional salary and attorney review costs (§ 84-712(3)(d)); RCFP text on residents' free hours is internally inconsistent.
fees.copy_rule: Actual cost of reproduction incl. staff time; AG treats $0.25/page or less as actual cost.
fees.waiver_rule: Custodian may waive or reduce fees in the public interest (§ 84-712(3)(h)).
fees.late_penalty: Charging more than reasonably calculated actual cost is a violation (§ 84-712.01(2)).

residency.rule_text: Since 2024 access extends to residents and all other interested persons (§ 84-712); nonresidents face the higher fee structure.

appeal.rule_text: Petition AG to review denial (§ 84-712.03); AG decides within 15 calendar days; requester may sue or demand AG sue (AG files within 15 days). No statutory filing limit.

format_rule: Requester may designate any form in which the record is maintained (§ 84-712(3)(a)); no new format must be created (§ 84-712(3)(c)).
notes: Extension: if exceptionally difficult, written explanation within the 4 days with earliest date and cost estimate; requester has 10 business days to respond. Silence not expressly denial per RCFP. nebraskalegislature.gov refused connection. Read both page halves.
